title: Authorization package executive summary (R-1, ART-PKG)
description: The executive summary of the authorization package and its submission to the authorizing official (SP 800-37r2 Task R-1 and Appendix F). XSUM-001 judges it.

subject.title: What the package asks the authorizing official to authorize

security.title: Consolidated view of the security information in the authorization package

privacy.title: Consolidated view of the privacy information in the authorization package, for a system processing PII

issues.title: Risk management issues the executive summary identifies and highlights

poam_items.title: POA&M items of the package the issue rests on

submission.title: Submission of the authorization package to the authorizing official

by.title: System owner or common control provider who submits the package

to.title: Authorizing official, or the designated representative, who receives the package

source.description: Trace token: an interview answer (INT-007.A3), an assumption (ASM-012, ASM-BASELINE-001), a product file with optional anchor (product/architecture.md#identity) or an artifact (ART-SSP).
